originalTitle: Western Midstream (WES) Outpaces Stock Market Gains: What You Should Know
summary: In the latest trading session, Western Midstream (WES) closed at $49.03, marking a +1.74% move from the previous day.
content:
In the latest close session, Western Midstream (WES) was up +1.74% at $49.03. The stock outpaced the S&P 500's daily gain of 0.86%. Meanwhile, the Dow gained 0.98%, and the Nasdaq, a tech-heavy index, added 0.96%.

The oil and gas transportation and storage company's shares have seen a decrease of 0.21% over the last month, not keeping up with the Oils-Energy sector's gain of 5.4% and outstripping the S&P 500's loss of 1.96%.

The investment community will be closely monitoring the performance of Western Midstream in its forthcoming earnings report. The company is forecasted to report an EPS of $0.89, showcasing a 2.3% upward movement from the corresponding quarter of the prior year. Our most recent consensus estimate is calling for quarterly revenue of $1.2 billion, up 25.52% from the year-ago period.

Looking at the full year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates suggest analysts are expecting earnings of $3.66 per share and revenue of $4.67 billion. These totals would mark changes of +22.82% and +21.47%, respectively, from last year.

Any recent changes to analyst estimates for Western Midstream should also be noted by investors. These latest adjustments often mirror the shifting dynamics of short-term business patterns. As a result, we can interpret positive estimate revisions as a good sign for the business outlook.

Research indicates that these estimate revisions are directly correlated with near-term share price momentum. To capitalize on this, we've crafted the Zacks Rank, a unique model that incorporates these estimate changes and offers a practical rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, running from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), holds an admirable track record of superior performance, independently audited, with #1 stocks contributing an average annual return of +25% since 1988. Over the past month, the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has moved 3.82% higher. As of now, Western Midstream holds a Zacks Rank of #1 (Strong Buy).

In the context of valuation, Western Midstream is at present trading with a Forward P/E ratio of 13.18. Its industry sports an average Forward P/E of 12.8, so one might conclude that Western Midstream is trading at a premium comparatively.

It's also important to note that WES currently trades at a PEG ratio of 1.42. Comparable to the widely accepted P/E ratio, the PEG ratio also accounts for the company's projected earnings growth. As of the close of trade yesterday, the Oil and Gas - Refining and Marketing - Master Limited Partnerships industry held an average PEG ratio of 1.42.

The Oil and Gas - Refining and Marketing - Master Limited Partnerships industry is part of the Oils-Energy sector. This industry, currently bearing a Zacks Industry Rank of 9, finds itself in the top 4% echelons of all 250+ industries.

The Zacks Industry Rank gauges the strength of our individual industry groups by measuring the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks within the groups. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

chineseTitle: 西部中游 (WES) 的涨幅超过股市：您应该知道什么
chineseSummary: 在最新的交易日中，Western Midstream (WES) 收于 49.03 美元，较前一日上涨 1.74%。
chineseContent:
在最近的收盘交易日中，Western Midstream (WES) 上涨 1.74%，至 49.03 美元。该股的日涨幅超过标准普尔 500 指数 0.86%。与此同时，道指上涨 0.98%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上涨 0.96%。

这家石油和天然气运输及储存公司的股价上个月下跌了 0.21%，落后于石油能源板块 5.4% 的涨幅，也超过了标准普尔 500 指数 1.96% 的跌幅。

投资界将密切关注西中游即将发布的收益报告的表现。该公司预计每股收益为 0.89 美元，较去年同期增长 2.3%。我们最新的一致预测是季度收入为 12 亿美元，比去年同期增长 25.52%。

纵观全年，Zacks 一致估计表明分析师预计每股收益为 3.66 美元，收入为 46.7 亿美元。这些总数较去年分别增加了+22.82%和+21.47%。

投资者还应注意分析师对西中游的估计最近的任何变化。这些最新的调整通常反映了短期业务模式的动态变化。因此，我们可以将积极的估计修正解读为业务前景的好兆头。

研究表明，这些估计修正与近期股价动能直接相关。为了利用这一点，我们精心设计了 Zacks Rank，这是一个独特的模型，融合了这些估计变化并提供了实用的评级系统。

Zacks Rank 系统从#1（强力买入）到#5（强力卖出），拥有令人钦佩的卓越业绩记录，经过独立审计，自 1988 年以来，#1 股票贡献的平均年回报率为 +25%。在过去的一个月里，Zacks 共识每股收益估计上升了 3.82%。截至目前，Western Midstream 的 Zacks 排名第一（强力买入）。

在估值方面，Western Midstream 目前的远期市盈率为 13.18。该行业的平均远期市盈率为 12.8，因此人们可能会得出结论，西中游的交易价格相对较高。

还需要注意的是，WES 目前的 PEG 比率为 1.42。与广泛接受的市盈率相比，PEG 比率也反映了公司的预期盈利增长。截至昨天收盘，石油和天然气 - 炼油和营销 - Master Limited Partnerships 行业的平均 PEG 率为 1.42。

石油和天然气 - 精炼和营销 - Master 有限合伙企业行业是石油能源行业的一部分。该行业目前 Zacks 行业排名为第 9 位，在所有 250 多个行业中处于前 4% 梯队。

Zacks 行业排名通过衡量各行业组内个股的平均 Zacks 排名来衡量各个行业组的实力。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
